def search_algorithm(src, dsts, G, num_partitions):
    """Cost-minimal broadcast routing with overlap-aware tie-breaking.

    Approach:
    1. Remove edges into src and self-loops; run ONE single-source Dijkstra
       from src to get optimum path cost and reachability for all dsts.
    2. For each dst, enumerate simple paths in nondecreasing cost but ONLY
       while they remain equal-cheapest (capped iterations for safety).
       Among the equal-cheapest candidates, pick the one sharing the most
       edges with paths already committed for earlier destinations. Every
       dst therefore pays the minimum possible path cost, while shared
       prefixes/edges are maximally reused across destinations (reducing
       redundant transfers under broadcast/union cost accounting).
    3. All partitions of a dst ride the same cheapest path (spreading
       partitions over longer alternatives was measured to increase cost).
    Every destination receives a COMPLETE src->dst path (validator-safe);
    unreachable destinations and dst == src are skipped gracefully.
    """
    h = G.copy()
    h.remove_edges_from(list(h.in_edges(src)) + list(nx.selfloop_edges(h)))
    bc_topology = BroadCastTopology(src, dsts, num_partitions)

    try:
        dist, _ = nx.single_source_dijkstra(h, src, weight="cost")
    except (nx.NetworkXError, nx.NodeNotFound):
        dist = {}

    chosen_edges = set()

    for dst in dsts:
        if dst == src or dst not in dist:
            continue
        try:
            opt = nx.dijkstra_path_length(h, src, dst, weight="cost")
        except nx.NetworkXNoPath:
            continue

        best_path, best_overlap = None, -1
        examined = 0
        for path in nx.shortest_simple_paths(h, src, dst, weight="cost"):
            examined += 1
            if examined > 200:
                break
            cost = sum(h[a][b]["cost"] for a, b in zip(path, path[1:]))
            if cost > opt + 1e-12:
                break  # only equal-cheapest candidates are considered
            edges = set(zip(path, path[1:]))
            overlap = len(edges & chosen_edges)
            if overlap > best_overlap:
                best_overlap, best_path = overlap, path

        if best_path is None:
            continue

        for j in range(bc_topology.num_partitions):
            for a, b in zip(best_path, best_path[1:]):
                bc_topology.append_dst_partition_path(dst, j, [a, b, G[a][b]])
        chosen_edges |= set(zip(best_path, best_path[1:]))

    return bc_topology
